subject: [PATCH 43/60] mm/page_alloc: fall back when a bind policy's nodes become private

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The original author posted a patch to address memory hotplug issues in page allocation. They proposed relaxing private request handling when nodes become private after memory removal.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses memory hotplug issues in the Linux kernel's page allocation mechanism. Specifically, it handles cases where a bind policy's nodes become private after memory removal. The patch relaxes the private request handling to drop the nodemask and allocate from common memory when no node is available.
